title: Incomplete Information
event: The system requests assistance, but the initial event package lacks enough context to identify the hazard.
context: Additional views reveal conflicting cues; uncertainty remains material. A confident operational resolution is not supported.

hold.feedback: Safe state maintained because available information did not support action.

context.feedback: Additional context acquired, but material uncertainty remains. Do not manufacture certainty.

guidance.feedback: Critical error: action taken despite unresolved material uncertainty.

escalate.feedback: Unresolvable uncertainty appropriately escalated while safe state was maintained.
